description: Expanded, normalized molecular feature library aligned with chemist terminology; consistent *_present booleans and *_site_count integers; refined SMARTS for aryl/vinyl halides; adds derived context features for coupling/SNAr sterics and PG lability.

schema_notes.scope: global unless stated; site-level optional for future
rdkit_smart_tips: Prefer permissive SMARTS first; tighten after audits.
Use separate tokens + logic for negatives (e.g., internal_alkyne = alkyne_present AND NOT terminal_alkyne_present).
Features are designed for both deterministic detection and LLM-based reasoning about synthetic feasibility.
